sloka: भयम् कच्चिन् न च अस्मासु कुतश्चित् विद्यते महत् ।कुतः निमित्तः शोकः ते ब्रूहि सर्व हित एषिणि ॥२-७४-२१॥
transliteration: bhayam kaccin na ca asmāsu kutaścit vidyate mahat ।kutaḥ nimittaḥ śokaḥ te brūhi sarva hita eṣiṇi ॥2-74-21॥

translations.english: 'O holy cow fear not. You wish the welfare of all, Has any great calamity befallen us from any quarter? I hope not. What is the reason for your sorrow? Tell me'.
